name: upnote-mcp
description: Search, read, and create UpNote notes from Claude Desktop.
long_description: Unofficial MCP server for UpNote on macOS. Reads your local UpNote SQLite database (read-only) and exposes search, tag filtering, note retrieval, and safe note creation through UpNote's official URL scheme. Requires the UpNote desktop app.
